io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.data

Class EmbeddingList

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.v2.service.vector.request.data.EmbeddingList
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    BaseVector

    public class EmbeddingList
extends Object
implements BaseVector
    A collection of vectors that is mainly used for searching vectors stored in a struct field. All vectors in the list must share the same vector type.

      void add(BaseVector vector)
      Adds a vector to the embedding list.
      Object getData()
      Returns the vectors of the list flattened into a single object, either as a list of float values for float vectors or as a merged ByteBuffer for binary, float16, bfloat16, and int8 vectors.
      PlaceholderType getPlaceholderType()
      Returns the placeholder type of the embedded vector list, derived from the type of the contained vectors.
